status: 36 manual difference-site reviews; no game source changes in this record.

manual_reviews.name: card_silverquill_pledgemage
manual_reviews.reason: The zero ECX ability argument moves across CMP/SETE/ADD used to compute the independent EDX special ability. ECX is unused between these positions. The remaining argument setup has no flag consumers before the same pump call.

manual_reviews.name: card_cowardice
manual_reviews.reason: The local cursor increment moves across two outgoing argument MOVs. Both read the current target card before advancing EBX, advance before bounce_permanent, and read the next player after the callback. The argument stores do not consume EBX or flags.

manual_reviews.name: card_trench_gorger
manual_reviews.reason: The omitted MOV ESI,4 is reached only after CMP ESI,4 succeeds and CMP player,1 succeeds, with no callback or intervening ESI write. The negative tutor-result exit bypasses that MOV on both sides. The same exiled count reaches real_set_pt.

manual_reviews.name: bruna_ability
manual_reviews.reason: A reload of the saved instance pointer into EDX moves ahead of TEST/JE. The successful path uses the same pointer after the same chooser callback. The failure edge clears spell_fizzled and enters test-definition argument setup, where EDX is overwritten/unobserved; the local stack slot is valid on both edges.

manual_reviews.name: card_falkenrath_noble
manual_reviews.reason: The count is masked to 0..255 and zero skips the loop. Each iteration decrements exactly once before the same life_sucking call; the local count does not escape. JG and JNE agree for every resulting 0..254 count. Moving DEC across argument MOVs changes neither arguments nor the post-call TEST condition.

manual_reviews.name: card_circle_of_protection_shadow
manual_reviews.reason: The target player/card loads and outgoing stores are scheduled differently using EAX versus ECX. Both loads occur after valid_target and before get_card_instance, with no intervening callback/store to the target record. The same two arguments reach the getter and its return replaces EAX.

manual_reviews.name: card_insubordination
manual_reviews.reason: The signed attachment-player guard is evaluated before rather than after loading the attachment card. No callback intervenes. With an ordinary valid instance record, an unused nonvolatile field load on the failing edge has no observable effect; successful paths retain both sign tests and current_turn equality.

manual_reviews.name: attached_gets_sp_kw2
manual_reviews.reason: The saved instance-pointer reload into EDX moves before the final humiliation-result guard. Successful paths retain both live attachment checks and both humiliation calls. The failing edge immediately returns void without consuming EDX. The tail call receives the same attachment pair and keyword.

manual_reviews.name: card_mox_amber
manual_reviews.reason: After copying the returned color word, complement and arithmetic shift use EAX instead of EDX. The final AND is commutative and yields color & arithmetic_shift(~color,31) in EAX on both sides. Only independent argument MOVs are crossed; AND resets the relevant flags before the call.

manual_reviews.name: card_black_knight
manual_reviews.reason: Both versions always call is_humiliated first. They then require both a zero result and EVENT_ABILITIES before affect_me/protection handling; only the two side-effect-free guards change order. EAX is unmodified by the event comparison, and the shared return resets it to zero.

manual_reviews.name: card_white_knight
manual_reviews.reason: Both versions always call is_humiliated first. They then require both a zero result and EVENT_ABILITIES before affect_me/protection handling; only the two side-effect-free guards change order. EAX is unmodified by the event comparison, and the shared return resets it to zero.

manual_reviews.name: card_deftblade_elite
manual_reviews.reason: The native current-turn branch duplicates the toughness load/add/store, whereas the rebuilt branch joins the existing common increment after the power subtraction. The same get_power callback precedes both updates; there is no callback between the power/toughness operations. Separate nonvolatile global fields have the same final values before provoke.

manual_reviews.name: is_monocolored
manual_reviews.reason: The count_colors result is decremented in EDX natively and EAX in the rebuild. The zero edge returns NULL and the other edge returns the same literal. DEC modulo 2^32 is zero exactly for input 1; scratch EDX and arithmetic flags are not C return values.

manual_reviews.name: card_tahngarths_rage
manual_reviews.reason: The is_attacking branch predicate is inverted together with its two arithmetic arms. Nonzero still adds 3 and zero still subtracts 2 from event_result. Both arms rejoin the same aura tail; their distinct scratch registers and arithmetic flags are not consumed before replacement/calls.

manual_reviews.name: card_timestream_navigator
manual_reviews.reason: Native saves library + count*4 in EBX; rebuilt saves the same library in ESI and count in EBX and uses an indexed store. Both capture library before count_deck and get_original_internal_card_id; preserved registers retain the same destination across both calls. The IID store still precedes obliterate_card.

manual_reviews.name: card_lathiel_the_bounteous_dawn
manual_reviews.reason: Zeroing the loop counter moves after the positive life_gained guard. The skipped counter is unused on the failing edge. Loop termination reverses CMP operands while using only JE, so equal iteration counts terminate at the same point. Calls and live instance target reads retain their order.

manual_reviews.name: card_tajuru_paragon

changed_site_context.instruction: rep stosd dword ptr es:[edi], eax
rep stosd dword ptr es:[edi], eax

manual_reviews.reason: The 104-byte reported-subtype record is zeroed at the same stack address. Native recomputes that address after REP STOSD; rebuilt preserves it in EDX while EDI advances. The same pointer reaches get_subtypes and the independent test pointer is prepared before the call in both versions.

manual_reviews.name: card_rooting_kavu
manual_reviews.reason: The graveyard pointer load moves after the count-minus-one sign guard. It occurs before the first indexed read and no callback intervenes on that edge. Empty/negative paths do not use the pointer before shuffle; ordinary valid nonvolatile engine-array storage makes the skipped load unobservable.

manual_reviews.name: card_generic_som_tapland
manual_reviews.reason: Native memory OR and rebuilt load/OR/store read and write the same 32-bit state field and OR the same tapped bit. There is no intervening callback. This is ordinary nonvolatile single-threaded card storage, not an atomic-access equivalence claim; flags and scratch EDX are unobserved before replacement/call.

manual_reviews.name: card_robber_of_the_rich
manual_reviews.reason: Hand-count comparison reverses both operands and signed JLE/JGE. The same current_turn and opponent indices are computed before the comparison, with no callback between the loads. EAX is overwritten by the subsequent deck load and ECX is scratch before the next call.

manual_reviews.name: card_glorious_enforcer
manual_reviews.reason: Life comparison reverses operands and signed JG/JL, preserving life[player] > life[1-player]. There is no callback between loads. Success only performs argument MOVs before the same pump call; failure resets EAX on return. The changed scratch EDX and subtraction flags are not observed.

manual_reviews.name: base_target_definition
manual_reviews.reason: The same disjoint target-definition fields receive the same player, 1-player, type and constants. Type passes through EDX instead of ECX and field stores are reordered without callbacks. The pointer is ordinary valid nonvolatile record storage; the void return does not expose scratch registers.

manual_reviews.name: counterspell_target_definition
manual_reviews.reason: The same disjoint target-definition fields receive the same player, 1-player, type and constants. Type passes through EDX instead of ECX and field stores are reordered without callbacks. Zone and special retain the counterspell values; the void return does not expose scratch registers.

manual_reviews.name: counter_activated_target_definition
manual_reviews.reason: The same disjoint target-definition fields receive the same player, 1-player, type and constants. Type passes through EDX instead of ECX and field stores are reordered without callbacks. Zone and special retain the activated-counter values; the void return does not expose scratch registers.

manual_reviews.name: card_scouting_trek
manual_reviews.reason: After TEST, native separate zero/negative exits and rebuilt JLE all skip the insertion loop when count <= 0. Native zero goes directly to cleanup, while the negative path also evaluates count > 1 and rejects it. Positive loops retain the native count+1 limit, including its extra array read. Reversed CMP operands feed only JNE; alignment padding differs.

manual_reviews.name: card_energy_chamber
manual_reviews.reason: CMP EAX,1 sets carry exactly when the unsigned input is zero; SBB EAX,EAX therefore yields -1 for zero and 0 otherwise. Rebuilt TEST/SETE/AND ff/NEG computes the same mask. The following AND 0x7b produces the same counter ID and replaces flags before the unchanged add_counters call.

manual_reviews.name: card_floodhound
manual_reviews.reason: Native computes ai_modifier + (-10*hand_count + 70); rebuilt computes (ai_modifier - 10*hand_count) + 70. The stored 32-bit value agrees modulo 2^32. The changed intermediates and flags are not read before investigate and the common ability tail. This packet review does not extend the signed C expression beyond its defined arithmetic domain.

manual_reviews.name: qsort_cardvalue_ascending
manual_reviews.reason: Both comparator arguments are loaded once, in reversed order and opposite scratch registers. SETG/SETL are correspondingly exchanged, giving (lhs>rhs)-(lhs<rhs) for all signed int pairs. Only EAX is the comparator result; flags and scratch registers are not part of its C return contract.

manual_reviews.name: target_is_already_enchanted
manual_reviews.reason: BL encodes player!=targeting_player natively and its complement in the rebuild. When card==targeting_card, native JE on BL==0 and rebuilt JNE on BL!=0 both skip exactly the same source permanent. Full decoded loops show BL is otherwise only tested here and preserved across callbacks; the next loop comparison overwrites branch flags.

manual_reviews.name: negate_combat_damage_this_turn_to
manual_reviews.reason: The alternate-text parameter load moves across argument MOVs before the unchanged create_targetted_legacy_effect call. Its positive test and the nonnegative result test change order without intervening side effects. Both must pass before the same tail call; plain void-return paths do not expose scratch EAX or flags.

manual_reviews.name: is_humiliated_by_instance
manual_reviews.reason: Native and rebuilt return flags & mode only for signed flags>0 and zero otherwise. They exchange which register holds mode and flags, commute AND, and share versus duplicate the return tail. No extra field read/callback is introduced; scratch EDX and flags are not C return values.

manual_reviews.name: mana_into_string
manual_reviews.reason: The black-symbol counter zero moves after its positive-amount guard, across an independent buffer-pointer MOV. The loop initializes ESI to zero before its first increment on both sides. Skipped paths enter the next-color setup without consuming that counter value; subsequent guards reset flags.

manual_reviews.name: support

changed_site_context.instruction: rep movsd dword ptr es:[edi], dword ptr [esi]
rep movsd dword ptr es:[edi], dword ptr [esi]

manual_reviews.reason: Both preserve the original target-array address: native computes ESI from EAX before loading AL, while rebuilt uses the unchanged EBX copy afterward. The later target-count guard moves across only a zeroed local counter and player-argument reload. Selection/counter callbacks and live target-count rereads retain their order.

manual_reviews.name: card_zegana_utopian_speaker
manual_reviews.reason: After the same is_what callback, the self-card exclusion and nonzero type-result guards swap order, with symmetric equality operands. Both failure edges reach the same next-card path. No count_counters call occurs unless both guards pass, and all live active-card bound reads remain.

manual_reviews.name: destroy_attached_auras_and_obliterate_card
manual_reviews.reason: The saved aura-player sign guard moves ahead of the saved card load, from ordinary valid local array storage. Both sign tests still precede kill_card_impl; no callback occurs between them. A skipped card load on a rejected entry cannot affect the next entry or final instance updates.

manual_reviews.name: can_cause_sacrifice
manual_reviews.reason: The extra caller count<=0 fast return is the initial return-1 guard of can_cause_sacrifice_part, hoisted by the compiler into this caller. Native retains it at the worker entry; rebuilt starts the worker at its positive-count body. No callback exists between the caller guard and tail transfer. Scope is this caller/entry boundary, not all worker callers or full worker equivalence.

scope: Manual explanations of the listed instruction differences with current source definitions and binary ranges bound by hashes. Not automatic complete-function, callee, whole-DLL or gameplay proofs. Ordinary valid object/stack storage, nonvolatile single-threaded engine fields, existing symbol identities and normal C ABI/callback behavior are assumptions. Raw comparison scores and candidates remain unchanged; no game rebuild is needed for this review-only checkpoint.
